HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Arg. m.]
Squeamish nausea in region of sternum, with vertigo and burning in scrobiculum.
Nauseous sensations with hunger ; nausea in his dreams.
Vomiting, with stool in afternoon.
Bitter, acrid fluid rises up in throat ; heartburn.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Arg. m.]
Digestion took place without pain in stomach. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Oppression in scrobiculum. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Anxiety and pressure in pit of stomach.
Burning in stomach, ascending to chest.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Arg. m.]
Cutting stitches under last left ribs.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Arg. m.]
Tympanitic puffing of right side of abdomen.
Abdomen sore to hard pressure ; slowly lessened after wind passes.
Expansion and sensation of fulness in epigastrium, with hunger.
Loud croaking in abdomen, with hunger.
Wind colic.
Every moment lancinating pain in hypogastrium, like pin-pricks. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Distension of hypogastrium ; which was exceedingly sensitive to contact. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Contraction and tension of abdominal muscles ; has to walk bent forward.
Bruised pain over left hip, and on whole left side of pelvis, with uterine weakness.
Painful soreness in whole abdomen, < when riding in a carriage. θ With uterine complaints.
Tendency to crampy pains in groins. Scirrhus uteri.
Sweat only on abdomen and on chest.
Sweat on abdomen. θ Exostosis on skull.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Arg. m.]
Soft, but scanty stool. θ Exostosis on skull.
Diarrhœa, with constant pain in left side of stomach, all morning, afternoon and evening, and next day.
Painless stools of undigested food.
Frequent urging in lower part of rectum, with discharge of small quantities of soft stool.
Dry stool, like sand, after dinner.
Alvine evacuation irregular, often lienteric diarrhœa. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Diarrhœa with constant pain in left side of stomach.
Sore between nates, around anus, and in groin, on moderate walking.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Arg. m.]
Passed five or six pints of urine in one night. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Urine turbid, sweetish, profuse at night. θ Diabetes.
Profuse urine.
Urination copious. θ Diphtheria ; scirrhous uteri, etc.
Polyuria.
Urine like whey, slightly turbid, of a sweet taste. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Urine pale, fetid, profuse, especially at night. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Enuresis nocturna, spasmodic form.
Albuminuria.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Arg. m.]
Seminal emissions almost every night, without erection, with atrophy of penis ; after onanism.
Yellowish-greenish gonorrhœa, of an indolent character from beginning ; of eight months' standing.
Very profuse gonorrhœal discharge, with contusive pain in testicle.
Greyish ulcers, with shaggy borders, on prepuce ; at same time in throat.
Crushed pain in testicles ; clothing increases pain on walking ; also evening in bed.
Scrotum and feet œdematous. θ Diabetes mellitus.
Pruritus scroti.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Arg. m.]
Prolapsus, with pain in left ovary.
Pain in left ovary and back, extending to front and downward. θ Prolapsus.
Pains in left ovary and loins.
Purulent, ichorous, sometimes bloody matter flows from uterine ulcers, filling room with unbearable stench. θ Scirrhus.
Neck of uterus looks spongy, deeply corroded ; face straw-colored ; bruised, tense feeling in groin ; urine copious ; cramps in thighs.
Metrorrhagia, large lumps with violent pains, < with every motion.
Hemorrhages at approach of climacteric period.
Prolapsus uteri ; pain in left ovary ; pain in small of back, extending to front and downward.
Sore feeling, as if ulcerated, in whole abdomen, < when riding in a carriage. θ Uterine diseases.
Mucous membrane of vagina wrinkled by descent of uterus. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Purulent, ichorous, horribly smelling and at times bloody matter filled vagina. θ Scirrhous uteri.
Ulcers of uterus discharging purulent, ichorous matter, sometimes bloody water, with unbearable stench. θ Prolapsus uteri.
Neck of uterus very much swollen, presented a spongy mass, deeply corroded with ulcers in different directions, it was impossible to discorver the os tincæ.
In less than three days foul smell was lost almost entirely. θ Scirrhus of os tincæ.
